purpose: Mechanism and validation links for hard-gap-only wave 11. These entries improve evidence coverage but do not imply raw-data possession or canonical admission.

entries.evidence: Two real industrial quality-cycle datasets contain 5,912 and 7,290 aligned cycles with binary quality labels; underlying data require author request.
Cycle-to-cycle controllers combine part weight with filling-level and burr-count inspection and recover target quality within roughly 10-15 shots, including after a material-viscosity disturbance.
entries.promotionUse: strong re-review; raw acquisition still needed

entries.evidence: Dual-cavity valve-gated hot-runner experiments include gate pressure, separate hot-runner temperature-controller energy, multiple materials and repeated cycles; article is CC BY but raw rows are not explicitly released.
Three injection-moulding datasets explicitly pair machine actions with Kistler cavity-pressure transitions; D1/D2 each contain 270 cycles and D3 contains 460 cycles.
14-month production records include machine/mould failure, preventive-maintenance, downtime, cycle time, good/defective quantities and operator comments, but full data are controlled/confidential.
Eight cooling circuits have explicit before/after flow measurements; average flow increased from 20.0 to 22.4 GPM after cleaning.
After six hours of cooling-pipe cleaning, reported cooling time decreased from 17 s to 13 s.

Measured antechamber volume/pressure trajectories are reproduced during hydraulic-to-electric machine transfer using iterative learning control, converging within a few cycles with high-quality molded parts.
2026 cross-machine transfer-learning study validates physical part weight and dimensional quality across injection machines using multisensor data and multiple sampling strategies.
Tool-mounted infrared temperature and piezoelectric pressure monitor PP-GF/PPS-CF overmoulding; datasets are explicitly available from authors on reasonable request.
PC/AA6061 injection-overmould joints link process parameters to lap-shear strength, fatigue to 10^6 cycles and 30-day hot-water aging; data available on request.
ABS/PC injection overmoulding links process settings to shrinkage, warpage and tensile strength and exposes publisher supporting information plus an author data-request route.
Six consecutive PCR-HDPE batches are individually characterized and then injection moulded, linking rheology/composition to injection pressure, torque, dimensions and part weight.
A recyclate batch change lowers shot weight and alters pressure; automatic switchover/holding-pressure control restores shot weight and cavity-pressure behavior near the reference range.
